instruction:
You are tasked with designing a 16-bit multiplexer module in Verilog. The module should have 8 input ports, each 16 bits wide, and 4 select lines. The select lines are used to choose one of the input ports as the output. The select lines are 4 bits wide, and the binary value of the select lines determines which input port is selected. For example, if the select lines are 0000, then the output should be the value of the first input port, while if the select lines are 1111, then the output should be the value of the eighth input port. The module should be named "mux16" and should be parameterized by the width of the input ports.

You are required to implement the "mux16" module using only one module within 200 lines of Verilog code.
